title: Feedback Request: What if Slay the Spire and Hearthstone Battlegrounds had a baby?
author: ZurkAtanis
selftext:
Hello,

  
Hoping to get some thoughts/feedback on my attempt at AI game dev. Still early, bugs, but the bones are there so feels like a good time to get directional feedback.

Appreciate your thoughts!

[https://zurkatanis.itch.io/auto-realms](https://zurkatanis.itch.io/auto-realms)

comments.author: AgenticGameDev
comments.body: Did not get it. Clicked and got to gym and was stuck.

replies.author: ZurkAtanis
replies.body:
As in the card battle at the gym didn't start? Or stuck as in the game was too confusing to progress?

Thanks for trying at least! 😄

replies.author: AgenticGameDev
replies.body: Confusing. To much happened and then at the end I was stuck.

replies.author: ZurkAtanis
replies.body:
Gotcha, yeah I will keep working on it, thank you! The tutorial helps some maybe, but sounds like it broke at the gym. 

I've been impressed with how few game breaking bugs Claude has made. Mostly just intent confusion with some things that seem hard to fix for it.

Again, appreciate you trying it!
